entities.name: Welsh nationalism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Welsh nationalism emphasises and celebrates the distinctiveness of Welsh culture, Welsh language and Wales as a nation or country. Welsh nationalism may also include calls for further autonomy or self-determination, which includes Welsh devolution, meaning increased powers for the Senedd, or full Welsh independence.
